values.note: $10/night for a single unit; $5/night for an extra vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/wood-lake-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $10 per night | Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'; last updated April 29, 2026), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/wood-lake-campground ('This small forest service campground has 9 campsites'; 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 22 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service page contradicts itself on water: the description says the campground 'provides restrooms and drinking water for campers', while its amenity list says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Bring water. Mandatory food storage (bear country).

values.note: Forest Service: 'Varies-late spring to early fall. Contact District Office to verify status.'

note: USFS (Helena-Lewis and Clark NF, Rocky Mountain Ranger District) campground 24 mi west of Augusta on Benchmark Road 235, beside Wood Lake (fishing and swimming; no motorboats); hiking trails skirt the camp. Bear country. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Apr 29, 2026): confirmed 9 sites, 22-ft recommended trailer max, $10 (+$5 extra vehicle), 14-day limit; added vault toilets and a season note (late spring to early fall, varies). Cleared derived potable_water (the page's amenity list says no potable water; its description says drinking water). Not on recreation.gov; the page says nothing on reservations (derived FCFS left). Alerts: prescribed fire, NCDE food storage, regional restrictions, Park Lake closure, FS Road 8998 closure - none for Wood Lake or Benchmark Road 235. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: Rocky Mountain Ranger District (Choteau) (406) 466-5341 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/offices/rocky-mountain-ranger-district-choteau); the campground page lists no contact. Operated by the Forest Service (no concessionaire named); not on recreation.gov, so first-come.
